entries.english: Witigo von Krumau, with the consent of his wife Sibille and their children, gives the newly founded Cistercian monastery at Hohenfurt the part of the so-called monastery forest that he held by hereditary right. The boundaries run from the Vltava along the road to Helfenberg, across the Lesser Vltawitz and the meadow Zbyadel, to the stream Mokri, Mount Hradisch, and the forest dividing Bohemia and Bavaria. The charter was issued at Hohenfurt on 1 June 1259 and witnessed, among others, by Bishop Johann of Prague and Bvdylaus, burgrave of Rosenberch.
